paragraph_heading: Design, biological unit, and analysis sets

exact_numeric_anchors: n=3 oxygen control and n=3 combined exposure; 7,461 submitted-partition audit cells; 90/7,461 Scrublet-predicted doublets (1.21%); 7,371 primary molecular-analysis cells; 7,367 conditional-composition cells after excluding the 94-cell partition 6.
row_selector: all rows; do not merge the 7,367- and 7,371-cell sets
required_caveat: No anesthesia-only arm; anesthesia and laparotomy effects cannot be separated; animal/library is the biological unit.
prohibited_wording: surgery caused; anesthesia caused; interaction effect; cells as biological replicates

paragraph_heading: Retrospective partition annotation and doublet/contamination audit
permitted_claim: The seven numeric partitions are a submitted computational solution; legacy biological names are traceability fields only. Partition 6 was doublet-enriched and was excluded from biological interpretation and conditional composition.
exact_numeric_anchors: Partition 6: 82/94 Scrublet-predicted doublets (87.2%), leaving 12 predicted singlets; other partitions: 8 predicted doublets total; highest BAM/CAM marker detection 1.515%; Ttr detection 46.126%-55.798% across partitions; partition-6 oligodendrocyte-lineage marker detection 98.936%-100%; 17,878 detected symbol-deduplicated genes; Table S1B has 14,390 retained positive-marker rows.

required_caveat: Per-cell marker statistics are descriptive annotation diagnostics, not biological-replicate inference; predicted doublets are not confirmed doublets.
prohibited_wording: validated states; confirmed doublets; proof of purity; ambient-RNA correction; published-signature alignment
